profile.visual_desc: Female knight with long grey hair riding a white horse. Wears silver plate armor with blue accents and a matching blue saddle cloth.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Determined female face with dark eyes, red lips, and long ash-grey hair featuring subtle top braids.
profile.weapon_desc: Long silver lance with a blue grip, held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Knight sits upright holding the lance vertically while the white horse stands still.
profile.step2_windup: Knight pulls the lance back and raises it high; the horse leans forward to build momentum for a thrust.
profile.step3_impact: A powerful forward thrust releasing a large, sharp conical yellow energy burst from the lance tip toward the top-left.
profile.step4_finish: Lance stays extended as the energy fades into small sparks, then the knight retracts the weapon to a horizontal rest.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The conical yellow energy effect in Frame 4 correctly follows the linear thrusting path of the lance toward the upper-left.

evaluation.diagnosis: The sequence successfully interpolates the reference frames. Mechanical integrity and VFX timing are consistent with the original thrust animation.
